description.ja: GUI操作に特化したVision-Language Agent。1120×1120高解像度対応。PC・Android両方のGUI操作が可能。9つのVLMベンチマークでSOTA。CVPR 2024 Highlightに採択。GLM-PCプロダクトの基盤モデル。
description.en: Vision-Language Agent specialized for GUI operations. Supports 1120×1120 high resolution. Capable of GUI operations on both PC and Android. SOTA on 9 VLM benchmarks. Accepted as CVPR 2024 Highlight. Foundation model for GLM-PC product.

description.en: Latest version based on GLM-4V-9B. Top performance on ScreenSpot, OmniAct, OSWorld. Adopted for GLM-PC product.
